_readme: S409 SkyOcotillo, 2026-10-17. Crafton Hills and Taft keep their catalogs on SmartCatalog (smartcatalogiq.com), a host the college read does not yet walk. Before any reader change, this read prints the host's own outline: the catalog's front page and the pages its program links open, one level deep, and the sitemap SmartCatalog hosts publish. Pages only, no model call, no table write.

questions.program_list: Where the catalog lists its programs (degrees and certificates): the page, each program's title, award and address.
questions.program_page: What one program page prints: the course list as code, title and units, any choose-N block, and the total.
questions.sitemap: Whether the host publishes a sitemap naming each program page.
